about_the_game:
CYBERSLAYER is a ruthless first-person action slasher that immerses you in the adrenaline-fueled rhythm of a cyberpunk future. You must overcome deadly trials within a giant megastructure, the last refuge of humanity after a global cataclysm.

Resources are running out, and the only sanctuary for survivors has turned into an arena for a merciless struggle for existence. The final battle is inevitable—its outcome will determine whether humanity has a future or faces total annihilation.

The game features over 15 diverse and colorful levels, where you must race against time. Your arsenal consists of only melee weapons, but that doesn’t mean the fight will be easy. You can throw your weapons at enemies or engage in brutal close combat, creating your own combat style.

All of this is accompanied by an unforgettable soundtrack that will fully immerse you in the cyberpunk world. Show no mercy. Spare no one. Only the fastest, most brutal, and most relentless will survive.
